comment: Invoice Submission Payload with PDF (DEPOT_PDF_API mode)
description: Complete example of an invoice submitted to Chorus Pro with a PDF attachment

fieldDescriptions.destinataire: Recipient/customer details with SIRET code and service code
fieldDescriptions.fournisseur: Supplier details with Chorus-specific IDs (from backend/context)
fieldDescriptions.idUtilisateurCourant: Current user ID from Chorus context (cannot be invented)
fieldDescriptions.lignePoste: Line items array with denomination, net amount, and VAT rate
fieldDescriptions.ligneTva: VAT lines array with base, amount, and rate
fieldDescriptions.modeDepot: Submission mode - use 'DEPOT_PDF_API' when a PDF is attached
fieldDescriptions.pieceJointePrincipale: Main attachment - REQUIRED for DEPOT_PDF_API mode
fieldDescriptions.pieceJointePrincipaleId: File ID returned from the PDF upload request

importantNotes: modeDepot MUST be 'DEPOT_PDF_API' when using a PDF
pieceJointePrincipaleId must be obtained from the PDF upload response
All amounts are in decimal notation (e.g., 45903.52)
All IDs (idFournisseur, idUtilisateurCourant, etc.) come from the backend context, not the PDF
destinataire.codeDestinataire is typically the customer SIRET
When calculating montants, ensure: montantTtcTotal = montantHtTotal + montantTVA
For TVA_SUR_DEBIT mode, tax is calculated on the invoice date
modePaiement options: CHEQUE, ESPECE, VIREMENT, etc.
howToUse: 1. First, upload a PDF using uploadPdf.sample.json and get the pieceJointeId
2. Replace 'pie-xxxx-yyyy-zzzz' with the actual pieceJointeId from the upload response
3. Fill in the supplier/fournisseur details from your Chorus context
4. Fill in destinataire details from the target customer data
5. Populate lignePoste and ligneTva arrays with the actual line items
7. POST this payload to /cpro/factures/v1/soumettre with Bearer token
